evidence: Touches shared unit test utilities in src/test/util/mining.{cpp,h} with the Tests label.
rationale: Fixes unit test mining helpers so that blocks attached to arbitrary parents correctly recalculate subsidy, target, and coinbase length. As noted in the description, 'Existing reorg tests can underpay without failing, while a fork crossing a halving can overpay and fail with bad-cb-amount', which restricted the helper's ability to construct valid fork tests across halving boundaries or at low heights.
